content.text: Creating a server component using Next.js `cookies()` and `headers()`, and integrating it into the home page.

success.diffString:
+import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
 
+function preferredLanguageFromAcceptLanguage(
+  acceptLanguage: string | null,
+): string {
+  if (!acceptLanguage?.trim()) {
+    return 'Not specified'
+  }
+  const first = acceptLanguage.split(',')[0]?.trim()
+  if (!first) {
+    return 'Not specified'
+  }
+  return first.split(';')[0]?.trim() || 'Not specified'
+}
+
+export default async function UserPreferencesDisplay() {
+  const cookieStore = await cookies()
+  const headerList = await headers()
+
+  const theme = cookieStore.get('theme')?.value ?? 'light'
+  const preferredLanguage = preferredLanguageFromAcceptLanguage(
+    headerList.get('accept-language'),
+  )
+
+  return (
+    <section aria-label="Server-detected preferences">
+      <dl>
+        <dt>Theme</dt>
+        <dd>{theme}</dd>
+        <dt>Preferred language</dt>
+        <dd>{preferredLanguage}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    </section>
+  )
+}
